scope: New additional Lorentzian R-squared candidate. Exact vacuum scalar, full homogeneous theorem and local boundary prescription only.

primary_sources.use: Established local F(R) boundary term and independent scalar boundary datum; no claim of full quantum boundary completion.
Distinguish frequency hierarchy, semiclassical response and induced fluctuations. No transfer of flat-space stability to the charged candidate.

closest_comparator: Standard positive-mass f(R) curvature scalar and scalar-tensor boundary formulation. New work here is the retained anomaly sign/normalization, a simultaneous numerical window with the existing full-Dirac magnetic product theorem, and an explicit versioned candidate decision.
